events.evidence: The yield spread between the Italian and German 10-year government bonds rises to over 2% for the first time in a year, due to the political uncertainty
U.S. President Donald Trump tweets that "very productive talks" are being held with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un on reinstating the June 12 Singapore summit
A senior Iranian official asks European powers to come up with a "Plan B" before the end of May, so that Iran may decide 'within weeks' whether to stay in the agreement

label.note: Italy bond stress and Iran JCPOA uncertainty offset by North Korea summit talks.
